description: Route evaluation fixtures for jvc skills. These cases document expected skill activation and near-neighbor boundaries; scripts/check-skill-evals.py validates fixture integrity and source-contract coverage.

cases.prompt: 按固定流程给和光智成首次建档，登记本地资料，完成 Data Layer 和 Invest Memo 后停在尽调前让我审核；后续要能恢复并查看项目状态。

near_neighbors.why_not: prescreen produces one standalone quick-screen artifact; this request owns project identity, resumable state, multiple stages, and a stop gate.
ic-memo produces the final L3 synthesis; this request starts at intake and must stop before diligence.

cases.prompt: 帮我快速过一遍这个 deck，做 L0 项目初筛，覆盖商业模式、上下游、赛道有效性、市场粗算、五年收入和交易回报。
skill_contract_signals: 不替用户作最终投资决定

near_neighbors.why_not: ic-memo is for full investment committee synthesis after multiple prior materials exist; this is a quick screen.
deal-flow is for persistent project identity and cross-stage orchestration; this request asks only for one quick-screen artifact.

cases.prompt: 把这段客户访谈逐字稿整理成一问一答的 Word 问答纪要，回答要保留完整回答、对应事实层维度和待验证点。
skill_contract_signals: 不得退回纯 prompt 模式
重新运行原有产物格式校验

near_neighbors.why_not: meeting-notes is the six-section fact note; this prompt asks for Q&A structure and complete answers.

cases.prompt: 根据这次创始人访谈逐字稿和我的现场随笔，生成结构化 Word 访谈纪要，按公司基本情况、技术、团队、产品、商业化、融资情况整理。
skill_contract_signals: 不得退回纯 prompt 模式
重新运行原有产物格式校验

near_neighbors.why_not: talk-notes should trigger when the user explicitly wants Q&A structure.

cases.prompt: 基于 deck 和访谈纪要，提炼这个项目为什么值得认真看的 bull case，按行业趋势、技术节点、团队优势、商业化进展写投资亮点和待验证项。
skill_contract_signals: 不得退回纯 prompt 模式
重新运行原有产物格式校验

near_neighbors.why_not: ic-memo synthesizes all prior materials into a seventeen-section memo; this prompt asks only for positive arguments.

cases.prompt: 基于这些项目材料做反向论证，扮演挑剔 LP、竞品 CEO、怀疑论同行和 IC boss，输出为什么不投以及可证伪条件。
skill_contract_signals: 不得退回纯 prompt 模式
重新运行原有产物格式校验

near_neighbors.why_not: bull-case extracts positive investment arguments; this prompt asks for adversarial no-invest arguments.

cases.prompt: 把 prescreen、bull case、bear case、赛道研究、竞品和回报模型合成 IC memo：先生成带证据和缺口的预审版，等我明确审批后再生成不含引用和证据状态的干净终版。
skill_contract_signals: 不得退回纯 prompt 模式

near_neighbors.why_not: bull-case only extracts positive arguments and must not produce the full investment committee memo.

cases.prompt: 帮我做一个玻璃基板赛道研究，先讲行业定义、行业简史、技术路线、产业链图谱、政策趋势和关键玩家。
skill_contract_signals: 不得退回纯 prompt 模式
重新运行原有产物格式校验

near_neighbors.why_not: comps-dd should trigger when the user asks for competitors/comparable companies and the fixed 03-comps-dd.md artifact.
research-report validates and renders finished research Markdown; this case asks to create the research content.

cases.prompt: 我已经有一份固定章节和 [S1] 来源索引的赛道研究 Markdown，请不要改内容，按 lustinus RESEARCH 版式生成可打印 PDF、HTML 预览和构建报告。

near_neighbors.why_not: track-research creates research content; this prompt already has finished Markdown and asks only for validation and rendering.
ic-memo synthesizes company diligence; this is an industry-report renderer.

cases.prompt: 读取这个玻璃基板 Obsidian 文件夹，把已有资料整理成递归问题树、Mermaid 图、nodes.json、证据索引和开放问题。
skill_contract_signals: 不得退回纯 prompt 模式
重新运行原有产物格式校验

near_neighbors.why_not: track-research owns first-pass web research; this prompt asks to transform existing local source files into reusable tree artifacts.

cases.prompt: 围绕这个项目做竞品分析，找直接竞品、可比公司、上下游参照和海外标杆，最后输出固定的 03-comps-dd.md。
skill_contract_signals: 不得退回纯提示词模式

near_neighbors.why_not: track-research builds the sector map; this prompt asks for company comparison output.

cases.prompt: 测算这个细分赛道市场规模，要同时拆解 TAM、SAM、SOM 的自上而下和自下而上模型，并输出单一可审计 CSV。
skill_contract_signals: 不得退回纯 prompt 模式

near_neighbors.why_not: track-research can establish the sector boundary and handoff variables, but it does not own the single-table CSV market model.

cases.prompt: 根据本轮条款、后续融资稀释、三种退出情形和财务预测，按母版做 MOIC/IRR 回报测算 CSV。
skill_contract_signals: 不得退回纯 prompt 模式
不得改变表头和行项目

near_neighbors.why_not: market-sizing estimates market size; this prompt asks for a formula-linked investment return CSV.

cases.prompt: 给实习生解释 TAM、SAM、SOM 分别是什么意思，举一个简单例子即可。
cases.no_route_reason: This is a teaching request, not a reusable market-sizing CSV model task.

cases.prompt: 整理这个月差旅发票，OCR 识别 PDF，人工复核后生成报销汇总 Excel，并按项目归档。

near_neighbors.why_not: comps-dd is diligence research; invoice-manager is operational filing and must not enter investment judgment.
